mapper.insert: insert into ai_call_log ( model_id, task_type, request_content, response_content, tokens_used, response_time, status, error_message, created_at ) values ( #{modelId}, #{taskType}, #{requestContent}, #{responseContent}, #{tokensUsed}, #{responseTime}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select id, model_id, task_type, request_content, response_content, tokens_used, response_time, status, error_message, created_at from ai_call_log where model_id = #{modelId}
select id, model_id, task_type, request_content, response_content, tokens_used, response_time, status, error_message, created_at from ai_call_log where status = #{status}

select id, model_id, task_type, request_content, response_content, tokens_used, response_time, status, error_message, created_at from ai_call_log where created_at >= #{startTime} and created_at <= #{endTime}
